cases.steps: 登录页进入注册页并返回；验证必填、格式、密码长度、一致性和重复账号；注册后登录、退出；分享链接上注册登录。
cases.inputs: ui_user、password123；空字段、短密码、不一致密码、重复用户名
cases.expected: 独立表单；错误提示明确且无无效注册写入；注册成功返回登录且不自动登录；登录进入首页或原问卷；退出会话失效。

@case('认证浏览器自动化', '登录页进入注册页并返回；验证必填、格式、密码长度、一致性和重复账号；注册后登录、退出；分享链接上注册登录。',
      'ui_user、password123；空字段、短密码、不一致密码、重复用户名',
      '独立表单；错误提示明确且无无效注册写入；注册成功返回登录且不自动登录；登录进入首页或原问卷；退出会话失效。')
def test_separate_auth_views(client):
    pw = pytest.importorskip('playwright.sync_api')
    _, sid, _ = setup_survey(client)
    sock = socket.socket(); sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
    origin = f'http://127.0.0.1:{sock.getsockname()[1]}'
    app = create_app(Settings(mongo_uri='mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017', database=client.app.state.db.name))
    server = uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(app, log_level='error'))
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.run, kwargs={'sockets': [sock]}, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    try:
        for _ in range(100):
            if server.started: break
            time.sleep(.1)
        assert server.started
        with pw.sync_playwright() as p:
            browser = p.chromium.launch(channel='msedge', headless=True)
            page = browser.new_page()
            errors = []; requests = []
            page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
            page.on('request', lambda r: requests.append(r.url) if r.url.endswith('/api/auth/register') else None)
            page.goto(origin)
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#confirmPassword')).to_have_count(0)
            page.locator('#register').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_have_count(0)
            pw.expect(page.locator('#registration')).to_be_visible()
            page.locator('#backToLogin').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            page.locator('#register').click()
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('请填写')
            page.locator('#username').fill('!bad')
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('用户名须')
            page.locator('#username').fill('ui_user')
            page.locator('#password').fill('short')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('密码长度')
            page.locator('#password').fill('x'*17)
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('x'*17)
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('8～16个字符')
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('different')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('不一致')
            assert requests == []
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('注册成功')
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#password')).to_have_value('')
            assert page.evaluate("sessionStorage.getItem('survey_token')") is None
            page.locator('#register').click()
            page.locator('#username').fill('UI_USER')
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('用户名已存在')
            assert client.app.state.db.users.count_documents({'username': 'ui_user'}) == 1
            page.locator('#backToLogin').click()
            page.locator('#username').fill('ui_user'); page.locator('#password').fill('incorrect')
            page.get_by_role('button', name='登录', exact=True).click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('用户名或密码错误')
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.get_by_role('button', name='登录', exact=True).click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#new')).to_be_visible()
            old_token = page.evaluate("sessionStorage.getItem('survey_token')")
            page.locator('#logout').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            assert page.evaluate("sessionStorage.getItem('survey_token')") is None
            assert client.get('/api/auth/me', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+old_token}).status_code == 401
            page.goto(origin+'/survey/'+sid)
            page.locator('#register').click()
            page.locator('#username').fill('share_reader'); page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('password123'); page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('注册成功')
            assert page.url == origin+'/survey/'+sid
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.get_by_role('button', name='登录', exact=True).click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#answerForm')).to_be_visible()
            from app.auth import digest, now
            import secrets
            salt = secrets.token_hex(16)
            client.app.state.db.users.insert_one({'_id':'browser_legacy','username':'browser_legacy',
                'salt':salt,'password_hash':digest('L'*128,salt),'created_at':now()})
            page.locator('#logout').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            page.locator('#username').fill('browser_legacy')
            page.locator('#password').fill('L'*128)
            page.get_by_role('button',name='登录',exact=True).click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#answerForm')).to_be_visible()
            assert errors == [], errors
            browser.close()
    finally:
        server.should_exit = True; thread.join(timeout=10); sock.close()
        assert not thread.is_alive()

cases.source:
def test_auth(client):
    h = login(client)
    assert client.get("/api/auth/me", headers=h).status_code == 200
    assert client.get("/api/auth/me").status_code == 401
    assert client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"username":"alice", "password":"incorrect"}).status_code == 401
    assert client.post("/api/auth/register", json={"username":"alice", "password":"password123"}).status_code == 409
    user = client.app.state.db.users.find_one()
    assert user["password_hash"] != "password123"
    assert "password" not in user
    assert client.post("/api/auth/logout", headers=h).status_code == 200
    assert client.get("/api/auth/me", headers=h).status_code == 401

def test_ownership(client):
    database = client.app.state.db
    database.surveys.insert_one({"_id":"s", "owner_id":"a"})
    assert owned(database,"s",{"_id":"a"})["_id"] == "s"
    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as e:
        owned(database,"s",{"_id":"b"})
    assert e.value.status_code == 404

cases.source:
@case('注册并发唯一性', '8个请求在密码哈希前汇合，确保均通过预查询后竞争插入。', '8次相同用户名', '只有1个201、7个409；MongoDB只有1条用户。')
def test_concurrent_duplicate(client, monkeypatch):
    from app import auth
    barrier = Barrier(8)
    original = auth.digest
    def synchronize(password, salt):
        barrier.wait(timeout=20)
        return original(password, salt)
    monkeypatch.setattr(auth, 'digest', synchronize)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
        responses = list(pool.map(lambda _: client.post('/api/auth/register', json=BODY), range(8)))
    assert sorted(r.status_code for r in responses) == [201] + [409]*7
    assert all(r.json()['detail'] == '用户名已存在' for r in responses if r.status_code == 409)
    assert client.app.state.db.users.count_documents({}) == 1

cases.steps: 隔离库删除测试索引并植入重复用户；重新启动应用；注册、登录及健康检查。
cases.inputs: 两条同名历史记录；一个新用户名
cases.expected: 启动可用；同名409、新账号503、重复登录409；健康降级；所有历史记录保持不变。
cases.source:
@case('历史重复用户保护', '隔离库删除测试索引并植入重复用户；重新启动应用；注册、登录及健康检查。', '两条同名历史记录；一个新用户名', '启动可用；同名409、新账号503、重复登录409；健康降级；所有历史记录保持不变。')
def test_existing_duplicates_safe_startup(client):
    database = client.app.state.db
    database.users.drop_index('username_1')
    database.users.insert_many([{'_id': 'old1', 'username': 'same_user'},
                                {'_id': 'old2', 'username': 'same_user'}])
    before = list(database.users.find())
    app = create_app(Settings(mongo_uri='mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017', database=database.name))
    with TestClient(app) as restarted:
        assert restarted.get('/').status_code == 200
        assert restarted.post('/api/auth/register', json=BODY).status_code == 409
        r = restarted.post('/api/auth/register', json={**BODY, 'username': 'new_user'})
        assert r.status_code == 503 and '唯一索引' in r.json()['detail']
        assert restarted.post('/api/auth/login', json=BODY).status_code == 409
        assert restarted.get('/api/health').json()['registration'] == 'blocked'
    assert list(database.users.find()) == before

@case('冲突索引保护', '隔离库用非唯一同名索引代替唯一索引；尝试注册。', 'username_1非唯一', '503；不删除索引、不写用户。')
def test_nonunique_index_blocks_without_replacement(client):
    d = client.app.state.db
    d.users.drop_index('username_1'); d.users.create_index('username')
    before = d.users.index_information()
    assert client.post('/api/auth/register', json=BODY).status_code == 503
    assert d.users.count_documents({}) == 0
    assert d.users.index_information() == before
